grammar.summary: 本课学习 used to 表过去习惯与退休叙事。

points.title: used to + 动词原形
points.explanation: 表过去经常、现在不再：He used to work in a small factory. 否定 didn't use to / usedn't to。与 would 的区别：used to 可接状态动词。

examples.en: Frank used to work in a small shop.
examples.cn: Frank 曾经在一家小店工作。

points.title: since then 完成时呼应
points.explanation: Since then, he has been the head of the company. since then = 从那以后，标志现在完成时。

examples.en: He is still trying to build up his business.
